summary: Brackett Field is a general aviation airport serving La Verne and the surrounding communities in eastern Los Angeles County, California. Nestled in the Pomona Valley near the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains, it is one of several county-operated GA airports in the LA region and supports flight training, aircraft rentals, and private aviation. The airport features a single primary runway and hosts several FBOs and flight schools catering to the local pilot community.
faqs:
Q: What is Brackett Field primarily used for?
A: It serves general aviation, including flight training, private aircraft operations, and recreational flying rather than commercial airline service.

Q: Which airlines fly into Brackett Field?
A: None. Brackett Field does not have scheduled commercial airline service; it is dedicated to general aviation.

Q: Who operates the airport?
A: The airport is operated by Los Angeles County as part of its system of general aviation airports.

Q: Are there flight schools available at Brackett Field?
A: Yes, the airport hosts flight training schools that offer lessons, aircraft rentals, and pilot certifications.
transport_tips: The airport is conveniently located near the I-210 and I-15 freeway interchange, making it accessible from much of the Inland Empire and San Gabriel Valley. Rental cars and rideshare services are the most practical options since there is no public transit station directly at the field. Parking is generally available on-site for visitors and pilots.
local_tip: Time your visit for clear mornings—mountain wave activity and afternoon thermals from the San Gabriel foothills can make pattern work and short cross-country flights more challenging later in the day, so early departures tend to offer the smoothest conditions.
